description: Land Acquisition - Nagoda, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple plots of land for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, including lot numbers, land names, assessments, extents, boundaries, and claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
